root_cause: Supabase function_logs for 2026-10-24T22:25:13.089Z contain MEASURED_BRAND_TEST_READ_UNAVAILABLE DB_TABLE_REJECTED:social_posts. The existing content orchestrator had just added read-only social_posts/social_metric_snapshots queries for measured-next-post intelligence but its internal DIRECT_TABLES allowlist did not include either table, and its DirectQuery adapter did not implement the subsequent .gte(observed_at) filter. Consequently the public-brand generator recorded SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE and suppressed both measured challenger and existing safe creative exploration.

observed_evidence.daily_evidence: 2026-10-25 LinkedIn company generation_evidence.measured_next_post_test.state=SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE; 4 provider-linked posts with observed impressions (1,13,5,10), below promotion thresholds

fix: Add only existing social_posts/social_metric_snapshots to content orchestrator's DIRECT_TABLES; normalize provider metrics JSON; implement SQL-bound observed_at >= timestamptz filter for snapshot table only; explicitly ban inserts, updates and upserts on both measurement sources. Keep exact tenant filtering, 72-hour freshness, minimum exposure and independent promotion guardrails unchanged. Reuse existing orchestrator cadence and publishing lane.
prevention_rule: Cross-check every newly added .from(table) call against the live direct SQL adapter table allowlist and every query method against DirectQuery; regression tests must prove read-only authority and bounded timestamp filter before production. Zero impressions/likes or revenue must never be synthesized from missing sources. No second scheduler, bypass, or new data store. Execute real query chains through the adapter in regression tests; static source-selection assertions cannot prove adapter method compatibility. Personal seven-day history uses the existing parameter-bound IN date set and never widens measurement-only gte authority. Inventory all callers, upload exact tested file bytes, and verify the remote Git blob hash equals the local tested blob hash before ready/merge. Never serialize a source repair with an unverified first-match replacement.
terminal_rule: Exact HEAD Required+CodeQL, protected merge, Supabase deployed code parity, genuine subsequent orchestrator readback must stop returning DB_TABLE_REJECTED and show real measured or WAIT_FOR_COMPARABLE_PROVIDER_METRICS; actual post/lead/revenue improvement remains unproven.
